optimization.state_snapshot_timing: after original optimizer.step returned and before final accepted-state audit

final_control_gradient.contract: total objective gradient in LBFGS control space after the existing final audit; includes control-prior and CVT/log-parameter chain terms, not an RTTOV H-adjoint norm

producer_time_window.scope: inclusive saved host states; local20s slot is a separate experiment

clock.forcing_hypothesis: one native-background forcing held for one local KDM20s step

kg dry air m-2 per native eta layer

physical_background_classifier.definition: sum over native levels of qc+qi+qs exceeds QTOT_MIN

adapter_metadata.operator_routing_policy: all-sky always; physical background class is metadata only
adapter_metadata.initial_state_control: zero initialized by existing dual minimizer
adapter_metadata.callback_count_note: counts non-None evaluator results only; exceptional/failed attempts are not included
adapter_metadata.runtime_call_count_note: underlying step/RTTOV calls are not instrumented by this adapter

physical_temperature_K.formula: T = th * pii with the same recorded forcing for both states

relative_humidity_percent.spatial_summary: grid-point ratio mean/range over the full native column
relative_humidity_percent.formula: 100 * KDM6 thermo.compute_rh(qv, phase-aware qs(T,p)); qmin lower floor only, no 100% cap
relative_humidity_percent.interpretation_limit: model q/qs ratio; not rigorously identical to observed vapor-pressure e/es RH

liquid_water_saturation_ratio_percent.spatial_summary: grid-point qv/qs_water ratio mean/range over the full native column
liquid_water_saturation_ratio_percent.formula: 100 * KDM6 thermo.compute_rh(qv, qs_water(T,p)); not clipped at 100%
liquid_water_saturation_ratio_percent.interpretation_limit: separate from phase-aware RH; a column mean is not a ratio of column sums
